# env-contract-check

> Offline Python CLI for validating .env files and process environment variables against a versioned TOML contract. Reports missing, empty, invalid, and unexpected variables and .env.example drift without serializing values. Zero runtime dependencies; Python 3.11+.

Install from the GitHub release or use the composite GitHub Action. The package is not published to PyPI.

## Documentation

- [GitHub Action](https://github.com/moisesaguiarjunior/env-contract-check/blob/main/docs/github-action.md): validate generated .env files before tag-triggered deployments.
- [Overview and quick start](https://github.com/moisesaguiarjunior/env-contract-check/blob/main/README.md): installation and runnable examples.
- [Contract reference](https://github.com/moisesaguiarjunior/env-contract-check/blob/main/docs/contract.md): types, fields, literal dotenv grammar.
- [CLI protocol](https://github.com/moisesaguiarjunior/env-contract-check/blob/main/docs/cli.md): flags, exit codes 0/1/2, stable diagnostic codes.
- [Output JSON Schema](https://github.com/moisesaguiarjunior/env-contract-check/blob/main/docs/output.schema.json): schema_version 1.
- [Agent integration](https://github.com/moisesaguiarjunior/env-contract-check/blob/main/docs/agents.md): execution and safe remediation.
- [Security boundaries](https://github.com/moisesaguiarjunior/env-contract-check/blob/main/SECURITY.md): reports omit values; names remain visible.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/moisesaguiarjunior/env-contract-check/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): pure validation and explicit adapters.
- [Contributor instructions](https://github.com/moisesaguiarjunior/env-contract-check/blob/main/AGENTS.md): local workflow and repository rules.
